name: shiny-modularization
description: Lessons from modularizing a large Shiny app (5400 lines) into modules. Trigger: (1) breaking monolithic Shiny app.R into modules, (2) plotly click events in Shiny modules, (3) showModal with plotOutput in modules, (4) sf/ggplot2 namespace confusion. Verified on Shiny 1.12.1, plotly 4.12.0.
